name: Concealed dart launcher
description: The concealed dart launcher was a type of dart shooter usually worn on the wrist and concealed by clothing. In 137 ABY while on a bounty hunting mission, Deliah Blue used her dart launcher during an encounter with a Bothan Jedi named Hosk Trey'lis.

data.name: Concealed dart launcher
purpose: To stun or sedate a target
